genreFirst.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE 
  query_args(genre_id,descendants,provider,search,kind,entity_id) AS (VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)),
  dimension_clock(as_of,now) AS (VALUES (?,?)),
    dimension_platform_contexts(provider,context) AS (SELECT NULL,NULL WHERE 0),
    dimension_source_entities(source_id,entity_id,kind) AS (
      SELECT id,recording,'recording' FROM scoped_sources
      UNION ALL SELECT id,release,'release' FROM scoped_sources WHERE release IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL SELECT s.id,p.project_id,'album_project' FROM scoped_sources s
        JOIN catalog_release_projects p ON p.release_id=s.release),
    dimension_facts AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT s.id source_id,m.entity_id,m.kind,f.field,json_extract(f.payload,'$.value') value
      FROM scoped_sources s JOIN dimension_source_entities m ON m.source_id=s.id
      JOIN metadata_identity_links l ON l.entity_id=m.entity_id AND l.state='confirmed'
      JOIN metadata_facts f ON f.target_id=l.target_id CROSS JOIN dimension_clock c
      WHERE f.field IN ('country','firstReleaseDate','releaseDate','primaryType','introduction','description')
        AND json_type(f.payload,'$.value')='text' AND 
  (json_type(f.payload,'$.usage') IS NULL OR
    (json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.display')=1 AND json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.cache')=1))
  AND (json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.expiresAt') IS NULL OR
    json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.expiresAt')>c.as_of)
  AND (json_extract(f.payload,'$.sourceProvider') IS NULL OR
    (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dimension_platform_contexts pc
      WHERE pc.provider=json_extract(f.payload,'$.sourceProvider')
      AND pc.context=json_extract(f.payload,'$.providerContext'))
    AND (json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.crossSource')=1 OR
      json_extract(f.payload,'$.sourceProvider')=s.provider)))
        AND (json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.expiresAt') IS NULL OR
          json_extract(f.payload,'$.usage.expiresAt')>c.now)),
    dimension_release_years AS (
      SELECT source_id,CASE WHEN
  (length(value)=4 AND value GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)>0)
  OR (length(value)=7 AND value GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
    AND CAST(substr(value,1,4) AS INTEGER)>0 AND CAST(substr(value,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
  OR (length(value)>=10 AND substr(value,1,10) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
    AND CAST(substr(value,1,4) AS INTEGER)>0
    AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d',substr(value,1,10),'+0 days')=substr(value,1,10)
    AND (length(value)=10 OR (substr(value,11,1)='T' AND julianday(value) IS NOT NULL)))
  THEN substr(value,1,4) END value FROM dimension_facts WHERE kind='release' AND field='releaseDate'),
    dimension_imports AS (
      SELECT b.entity_id,a.payload,a.disposition,row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY b.entity_id ORDER BY a.plugin_id,a.legacy_id) position
      FROM metadata_legacy_bindings b JOIN metadata_legacy_albums a USING(plugin_id,legacy_id)
      JOIN metadata_legacy_documents d USING(plugin_id)
      WHERE d.state='published'),
    dimension_import_descriptions AS (
      SELECT entity_id,substr(json_extract(payload,'$.description'),1,20000) description,
        coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.descriptionSource.method'),'historical') method
      FROM dimension_imports WHERE position<=8 AND disposition='bound'
        AND json_type(payload,'$.description')='text' AND length(json_extract(payload,'$.description'))>0),
    dimension_effective_imports AS (
      SELECT i.entity_id FROM dimension_import_descriptions i WHERE i.method='external-ai'
        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dimension_import_descriptions ai
          WHERE ai.entity_id=i.entity_id AND ai.method='external-ai')
      GROUP BY i.entity_id HAVING count(DISTINCT i.description)=1),
    dimension_known_values(source_id,dimension,value) AS (
      SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL WHERE 0),
    dimension_names(dimension) AS (SELECT NULL WHERE 0),
    source_dimensions AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT source_id,dimension,value FROM dimension_known_values WHERE value IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL SELECT s.id,n.dimension,'unknown' FROM scoped_sources s CROSS JOIN dimension_names n
        WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dimension_known_values v WHERE v.source_id=s.id
          AND v.dimension=n.dimension AND v.value IS NOT NULL)),
  genre_tree(id) AS (
    SELECT id FROM music_genres WHERE id=(SELECT genre_id FROM query_args)
    UNION SELECT g.id FROM music_genres g JOIN genre_tree p ON g.parent_id=p.id
      WHERE (SELECT descendants FROM query_args)=1),
  scoped_sources AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.id,s.provider,s.track_id,s.recording,s.release,
      s.availability,s.preferred_recording,
      NULL collection_id
    FROM catalog_bindings s LEFT JOIN tracks t ON s.provider='local' AND t.id=s.track_id
    WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_memberships m WHERE m.source_id=s.id)
      AND (s.provider<>'local' OR (t.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_pending p WHERE p.track_id=s.track_id)))),
  genre_targets AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT 'source' target_kind,id target_id FROM scoped_sources
    ),
  manual_targets AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.target_kind,o.target_id,o.genre_ids FROM music_genre_overrides o
      JOIN genre_targets t USING(target_kind,target_id)
    UNION ALL SELECT o.target_kind,o.target_id,o.genre_ids FROM music_genre_import_overrides o
      JOIN genre_targets t USING(target_kind,target_id)
      WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM music_genre_overrides m
        WHERE m.target_kind=o.target_kind AND m.target_id=o.target_id)),
  bridge_groups AS (
    SELECT provider,normalized,min(genre_id) genre_id,min(ignored) ignored,
      count(DISTINCT coalesce(genre_id,'')||':'||ignored) variants
    FROM music_genre_alias_bridges GROUP BY provider,normalized),
  evidence_resolved AS (
    SELECT e.target_kind,e.target_id,e.origin,
      CASE WHEN a.provider IS NOT NULL THEN a.genre_id
        WHEN b.provider IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN b.variants=1 THEN b.genre_id ELSE NULL END
        ELSE g.genre_id END genre_id
    FROM music_genre_evidence e JOIN genre_targets t USING(target_kind,target_id),json_each(e.values_json) v
    LEFT JOIN music_genre_aliases a ON a.provider=e.provider AND a.normalized=json_extract(v.value,'$.normalized')
    LEFT JOIN bridge_groups b ON b.provider=e.provider AND b.normalized=json_extract(v.value,'$.normalized')
    LEFT JOIN music_genre_aliases g ON g.provider='*' AND g.normalized=json_extract(v.value,'$.normalized')),
  evidence_genres AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.target_kind,e.target_id,e.origin,e.genre_id
    FROM evidence_resolved e JOIN music_genres g ON g.id=e.genre_id),
  evidence_levels AS (
    SELECT target_kind,target_id,max(CASE origin WHEN 'source' THEN 2 WHEN 'external' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) level
    FROM evidence_genres GROUP BY target_kind,target_id),
  target_levels AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT t.*,CASE WHEN m.target_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'manual'
      WHEN e.level=2 THEN 'source' WHEN e.level=1 THEN 'external' ELSE 'none' END origin
    FROM genre_targets t LEFT JOIN manual_targets m USING(target_kind,target_id)
      LEFT JOIN evidence_levels e USING(target_kind,target_id)),
  target_genres AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.target_kind,m.target_id,CAST(v.value AS TEXT) genre_id
    FROM manual_targets m,json_each(m.genre_ids) v JOIN music_genres g ON g.id=v.value
    UNION SELECT e.target_kind,e.target_id,e.genre_id FROM evidence_genres e
      JOIN target_levels l USING(target_kind,target_id) WHERE e.origin=l.origin),
  entity_source_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM (SELECT recording entity_id,id source_id
        FROM catalog_bindings
        )),
  entity_sources AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT  s.recording entity_id,s.id source_id,s.provider,s.collection_id,
      s.recording,s.release,s.availability
    FROM scoped_sources s 
      CROSS JOIN catalog_entities e ON e.id=s.recording CROSS JOIN query_args q
    WHERE e.kind=q.kind AND (q.provider IS NULL OR s.provider=q.provider)
      AND (q.entity_id IS NULL OR e.id=q.entity_id)
      AND (1)),
  entity_direct AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.entity_id FROM entity_sources s JOIN target_levels l
      ON l.target_kind='collection' AND l.target_id=s.collection_id
    WHERE (SELECT kind FROM query_args)='release' AND l.origin<>'none'),
  entity_genres AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.entity_id,g.genre_id FROM entity_sources s JOIN target_genres g
      ON g.target_kind='source' AND g.target_id=s.source_id
    WHERE (SELECT kind FROM query_args)='recording'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entity_direct d WHERE d.entity_id=s.entity_id)
    UNION SELECT s.entity_id,g.genre_id FROM entity_sources s JOIN target_genres g
      ON g.target_kind='collection' AND g.target_id=s.collection_id
      WHERE (SELECT kind FROM query_args)='release'),
  entity_counts AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT entity_id,count(*) source_count FROM entity_sources GROUP BY entity_id),
  selected_entities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT e.id,e.kind,e.title,e.artist,e.identity,s.source_count,
      CASE WHEN e.kind='recording' AND e.id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM entity_genres) THEN 'direct'
        WHEN e.kind='release' AND e.id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM entity_direct) THEN 'direct'
        WHEN e.id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM entity_genres) THEN 'from-tracks' ELSE 'none' END classification
    FROM entity_counts s CROSS JOIN catalog_entities e ON e.id=s.entity_id CROSS JOIN query_args q
    WHERE (q.search='' OR instr(lower(e.title),q.search)>0 OR instr(lower(e.artist),q.search)>0)
      AND (q.genre_id IS NULL OR e.id IN (SELECT g.entity_id FROM entity_genres g JOIN genre_tree t ON t.id=g.genre_id))),
  matched_members AS (SELECT s.* FROM entity_sources s JOIN selected_entities e ON e.id=s.entity_id)
  
      , selected_page AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT * FROM selected_entities ORDER BY title COLLATE NOCASE,id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?),
      page_genre_rows AS (
        SELECT g.entity_id,n.id,n.name,n.name_en,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g.entity_id) genre_total,
          row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY g.entity_id ORDER BY n.name_en,n.id) ordinal
        FROM entity_genres g JOIN selected_page p ON p.id=g.entity_id JOIN music_genres n ON n.id=g.genre_id),
      page_genres AS (
        SELECT entity_id,max(genre_total) genre_total,
          json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'name',name,'nameEn',name_en)) genres
        FROM (SELECT * FROM page_genre_rows WHERE ordinal<=32 ORDER BY entity_id,ordinal) GROUP BY entity_id)
      SELECT p.*,t.total,t.providers,g.genres,g.genre_total FROM (
        SELECT count(*) total,(SELECT json_group_array(provider) FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM scoped_sources ORDER BY provider)) providers FROM selected_entities
      ) t LEFT JOIN selected_page p ON 1 LEFT JOIN page_genres g ON g.entity_id=p.id
      ORDER BY p.title COLLATE NOCASE,p.id

      focus_matched_sources AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.* FROM focus_sources s JOIN focus_matches e ON e.group_key=s.group_key WHERE 1),

      focus_source_counts AS (SELECT group_key,count(*) source_count FROM focus_matched_sources GROUP BY group_key),

      focus_results AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.group_key,e.id,e.personal_rating,e.preference,e.last_played,e.title,e.artist,
        y.release_year,r.id source_id,r.provider,r.in_library,c.source_count
        FROM focus_matches e JOIN focus_source_ranked r ON r.group_key=e.group_key AND r.choice=1
        JOIN focus_source_counts c ON c.group_key=e.group_key LEFT JOIN focus_result_years y ON y.group_key=e.group_key),

        SELECT s.*,coalesce((SELECT json_array('identity','recording',l.target_id) FROM metadata_identity_links l JOIN metadata_entities me ON me.id=l.target_id AND me.kind='recording' WHERE l.entity_id=s.recording_id AND l.kind='recording' AND l.state='confirmed'),json_array('entity','recording',s.recording_id)) recording_key FROM focus_matched_sources s WHERE s.in_library=1),
      focus_play_ranked AS (SELECT s.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY recording_key ORDER BY preferred_recording DESC,member_added IS NULL,member_added,id) recording_choice FROM focus_play_candidates s),
      focus_play AS (SELECT s.*,e.title entity_title,e.artist entity_artist,e.personal_rating,e.last_played,e.release_year FROM focus_play_ranked s JOIN focus_results e ON e.group_key=s.group_key WHERE s.recording_choice=1)
    , focus_facet_values AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.provider value,s.provider label,count(DISTINCT s.group_key) count FROM focus_matched_sources s GROUP BY s.provider), focus_facet_page AS (
        SELECT * FROM focus_facet_values ORDER BY count DESC,value LIMIT ? OFFSET ?)
        SELECT p.*,t.total FROM (SELECT count(*) total FROM focus_facet_values) t LEFT JOIN focus_facet_page p ON 1
        ORDER BY count DESC,value

WITH 
  album_args(entity_id) AS (VALUES (?)),
  album_members AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.id,s.provider,s.recording,s.release_id,s.release,s.preferred_release,s.availability
    FROM catalog_bindings s LEFT JOIN tracks t
      ON s.provider='local' AND t.id=s.track_id
    WHERE s.release_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_memberships m WHERE m.source_id=s.id)
      AND (s.provider<>'local' OR (t.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_pending p WHERE p.track_id=s.track_id)))),
  album_relations AS (
    SELECT s.*,p.project_id,pp.project_id playback_project_id,
      rl.target_id release_target,pl.target_id project_target,
      CASE WHEN rl.target_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'metadata:'||rl.target_id
        ELSE 'catalog:'||s.release_id END release_group,
      CASE WHEN pl.target_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'metadata:'||pl.target_id
        WHEN p.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'catalog:'||p.project_id
        ELSE 'release:'||s.release_id END project_group
    FROM album_members s JOIN catalog_entities e ON e.id=s.release_id AND e.kind='release'
    LEFT JOIN catalog_release_projects p ON p.release_id=s.release_id
    LEFT JOIN catalog_release_projects pp ON pp.release_id=s.release
    LEFT JOIN metadata_identity_links rl ON rl.entity_id=s.release_id
      AND rl.kind='release' AND rl.state='confirmed' AND rl.target_id IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN metadata_identity_links pl ON pl.entity_id=p.project_id
      AND pl.kind='album_project' AND pl.state='confirmed' AND pl.target_id IS NOT NULL),
  album_requested AS (
    SELECT r.* FROM album_relations r CROSS JOIN album_args a
    WHERE r.release=a.entity_id OR r.release_id=a.entity_id OR r.project_id=a.entity_id
      OR r.playback_project_id=a.entity_id),
  album_anchor AS (
    SELECT r.* FROM album_requested r CROSS JOIN album_args a
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.release_id=a.entity_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      r.preferred_release DESC,r.release_id,r.id LIMIT 1),
  album_requested_projects AS (SELECT DISTINCT project_group FROM album_requested),
  album_project_sources AS (
    SELECT r.* FROM album_relations r JOIN album_requested_projects p USING(project_group)),
  album_release_groups AS (
    SELECT r.release_group id,
      coalesce(min(CASE WHEN r.release_id=a.release_id THEN r.release_id END),min(r.release_id)) entity_id,
      min(r.release_target) metadata_target,
      max(CASE WHEN r.release_group=a.release_group THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current,
      count(DISTINCT r.id) source_count,count(DISTINCT r.release) playback_version_count
    FROM album_project_sources r CROSS JOIN album_anchor a GROUP BY r.release_group),
  album_releases AS (
    SELECT g.*,e.title,e.artist FROM album_release_groups g JOIN catalog_entities e ON e.id=g.entity_id)
 , album_page AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT * FROM album_releases ORDER BY current DESC,title COLLATE NOCASE,id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?)
        SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM album_requested_projects) project_count,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM album_releases) total,
          (SELECT json_object('id',r.id,'entity_id',r.entity_id,'metadata_target',r.metadata_target,'current',r.current,'source_count',r.source_count,'playback_version_count',r.playback_version_count,'title',r.title,'artist',r.artist) FROM album_releases r WHERE current=1) current_release,
          (SELECT json_object('id',e.id,'title',e.title,'artist',e.artist,'project_target',a.project_target)
            FROM album_anchor a JOIN catalog_entities e ON e.id=a.project_id
            WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM album_requested_projects)=1) project,
          (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',p.id,'entity_id',p.entity_id,'metadata_target',p.metadata_target,'current',p.current,'source_count',p.source_count,'playback_version_count',p.playback_version_count,'title',p.title,'artist',p.artist))
            FROM (SELECT * FROM album_page ORDER BY current DESC,title COLLATE NOCASE,id) p) items
